name: fluxwp

scripts.dev: bun run brand && turbo run dev --filter=@fluxwp/panel
scripts.build: bun run brand && turbo run build
scripts.desktop:dev: bun run brand && bun run --filter @fluxwp/desktop icons && cd apps/desktop && bun run tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.brand.conf.json
scripts.desktop:build: bun run brand && bun run --filter @fluxwp/desktop icons && cd apps/desktop && bun run tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.brand.conf.json

description: FluxWP (React panel + Tauri) ve paylaşılan TS kütüphaneleri. WordPress eklentileri plugins/, temalar themes/ altında.
